map: mob-saturation survey - standing hostile population of the league home range
method: NO-BODY read-only parse of the Orin server saved entity store (world/dimensions/minecraft/overworld/entities/*.mca x4, md5-verified copies) - no login, no bot, no op command, no world edit; sample-clone risk does not arise. Source files md5 at capture: r.0.0 a215aa5c089d9b4c52c970080a91a06a, r.0.-1 781ddf0c9ab8152cc7674e2af834b753, r.-1.0 35f66d57e674f6258b053fab4f27e86b, r.-1.-1 2853e2bfee4833d5a4e9e16d054789c7. Caveats: saved-position snapshot (mobs in chunks unloaded since the autosave keep their last saved spot); a persistently-unloaded mob re-enters play only when its chunk loads again.
world_context_at_capture: UNHELD NIGHT at capture: timeOfDay ~18050-18770 (pulse/deaths.jsonl 07:12-07:13Z), ~70 Cody mob-death lines in latest.log, last /time set 1000 by the cameraman at 05:58:42Z - the daylight hold had been down ~1.4h. Cody emergency-held offline 07:21:13Z (emergency-hold-cody-20261107) and relaunched 07:22:49Z by the Priority-2 lane. Accounts for part of tonights surface count; the deep standing population (this map) predates tonight.

totals.note: 172 of 294 hostiles are deep-underground (caves, mostly y<45 incl. 744-bat cave systems) - the saturation is overwhelmingly a cave population, not a surface army.

headline: NOT a saturation blanket: only 6 persisted hostiles stand in the whole spawn->homestead working band (x26..72,z-108..-80) at surface level, ZERO inside the homestead pad/apron-12, and exactly ONE inside the respawn-march corridor box (x32..64,z-100..-92): a pocket skeleton at (36.6,64.9,-92.9), ~2.5 below the column top in the hollow row, 2 blocks from the Trial-8 pin cell (38.6,66,-93.3) - pocket-shaded, the Trial 7 profile, daylight-persistent until cleared. The rest of Trial 7s 7-death corridor grind is NOT reproduced by tonights standing population - those killers were night-window spawns, mostly since despawned/burned; the standing map cannot explain it, and says so.

ACTIVE DAYLIGHT-PERMANENT THREAT - Geist apron: a HELMETED skeleton (golden helmet, bow) at (0.5,67,-93.5), Chebyshev 10 from Geists anchor (7,-85), inside his west collecting apron and 8.5 blocks from his old parked position (38.7,65,-94.7 is E; the skeleton sits W of the anchor). It does not burn at dawn. Plus a creeper at (20.5,69,-93.8) (daylight-permanent) inside apron-24. Filed to lineage-c via pulse ledger note (geist side shares the pulse ledger; no separate lineage-c ledger file exists).

ACTIVE DAYLIGHT-PERMANENT THREAT - homestead outer apron & Vega apron share it: TWO creepers at Chebyshev 16 from Cody homestead anchor (64,-93): (70.2,67,-80.5) NE and (69.6,67,-107.5) SE, both on the aprons outer rim; creepers never burn. Inside Vega apron-12/24 too. Two unhelmeted zombies at (61.8,68,-78.8) and (63.2,68,-88.8) stand in the Vega-side NE ground N of the homestead (burn at dawn if open sky).

SPAWN plateau is NOT clear at night: inside the spawn-protection square (Cheb<=16) stand a zombie (32.5,67,-88.2) ON the plateau 7.8 from spawn point, the pocket skeleton (36.6,64.9,-92.9, hp 11), a zombie (30.5,70,-107.2, hp 8.2) S, another zombie (29.2,69,-109) SW (shade unverified), the canopy spider (41.7,71.1,-87.8) E, and a daylight-permanent creeper (20.5,69,-93.8) on the squares W edge. The unhelmeted zombies burn at dawn; the pocket skeleton is shaded and may not. Lethal to a fresh respawn at night - exactly the Trial 7/8 respawn-grind profile while the hold is down.

DAYLIGHT REALITY CHECK: of ~100 surface-band hostiles only ~46 are daylight-capable at all (20 creepers + 22 endermen + spiders turn neutral); every zombie/skeleton in the working geography is unhelmeted EXCEPT the one golden-helmet skeleton at Geists door. Under a WORKING daylight hold the standing surface threat in citizen geography collapses to THREE daylight-permanent hostiles: creeper (70.2,-80.5) + creeper (69.6,-107.5) on the homestead aprons outer rim (Cheb 16), and the Geist-apron pair sharing one creeper (20.5,-93.8) + the golden-helmet skeleton (0.5,-93.5); plus one daylight-PERSISTENT pocket risk: the hollow-row skeleton (36.6,-92.9) at the corridor W end. Spiders/endermen persist but are neutral by day. The lethal variable is the HOLD, not the population.
